label: alg:frobenius-pairing
title: Frobenius pairing $\langle a, b\rangle_F$ and self-duality $\Psi = S^2 = \mathrm{id}$
html:
Algorithm. Frobenius pairing \langle a, b\rangle_F and self-duality \Psi = S^2 = \mathrm{id}

Algorithm (Frobenius pairing + self-duality check). Compute the symmetric bilinear pairing \langle a, b\rangle_F = \mathrm{tr}_M(a \cdot b) on H_n(q) and verify the categorical self-duality \Psi = S^2 = \mathrm{id} (Frobenius pairing and self-duality).

Input

  • Two Hecke normal forms a, b \in H_n(q) (output of Step 2).
  • Substrate parameter q \in R.

Output

  • Scalar \langle a, b\rangle_F \in R[q, q^{-1}].
  • Boolean assertion that S^2 = \mathrm{id} holds on a (and on every basis T_w).

Algorithm

1. Compute the product a · b in H_n(q) via GS reduction (Step 2).
2. Apply tr_M to the product (Step 3).
3. Optional: verify self-duality by computing S(a) and S(S(a))
   on each basis element T_w; assert S²(T_w) = T_w.

Correctness conditions

  1. def:frobenius-pairing defines \langle a, b\rangle_F as the Markov trace of the product, making it symmetric and non-degenerate.
  2. prop:frobenius-pairing-exists gives existence in the QOU rigid-monoidal premise.
  3. prop:frobenius-pairing-unique makes the pairing canonical (up to the chosen Markov parameter).

Complexity

O(\dim H_n(q)) products + a single trace; dominated by Step 2 (GS reduction). The S^2 = \mathrm{id} check is O(\dim H_n(q)) basis-element verifications.

Python API entry point

from pyhecke import check_frobenius

# Verifies Frobenius positivity Gx ≥ 0 on the standard basis vector x.
ok = check_frobenius(x)

The canonical verification script is computations/audit_frobenius_pairing.py; the Gram matrix G and the Markov-trace vector TR_M are exposed as constants by pyhecke.

Witness contract

No standalone numerical witness file. Structural checks live in computations/audit_frobenius_pairing.py; the S^2 = \mathrm{id} assertion is part of the Hecke-core regression suite.

Notes

The Frobenius pairing makes H_n(q) a rigid Frobenius algebra. Categorical self-duality is dual to it under decategorification. Both ensure the Wedderburn decomposition (Step 5) lands in the correct basis.
